sourceQuote: UIBE is the top university in the fields of economics and business. It offers almost 40 majors to overseas students for bachelors, masters and PhD level in the fields of economics, management, liberal arts, law, science, and international trade, finance, business management, and foreign languages.
targetQuote: 对外经贸大学在经济和商业领域处于顶尖地位。它为留学生提供近40个本科、硕士和博士专业，涵盖经济、管理、文学、法学、科学，以及国际贸易、金融、商业管理和外语等领域。
